audit.whatIsWrong: packet flags the exact defect: content win[0..5]=Swain/win[6]=Seraphine, but every full-layer phases[N].side read the placeholder 'Skill', and the phases[N].why text described the OWNER winning rows the content layer already says Swain wins.
audit.why: A reader sees the level chart, the win row, and the why sentence disagree with each other on who wins levels 1-5.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0..5].side to Swain and phases[6].side to Seraphine to match the already-correct win[N], and rewrote each why to state the actual Swain-favoring (or late-game Seraphine-favoring) reason instead of the generic owner-positive template.

audit.why: Swain's W vision/root threat and E-into-support kill setup win lane; his R drain sustain wins level 6 and one-item fights; Seraphine's longer range and Encore chain-CC overtake late.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); Swain's percent-health passive (resistances-invalidated) wasn't stated anywhere on the page even though itemization already correctly calls for early anti-heal.
audit.why: Nevermove is down 12s early/10s maxed and his R is a 120s drain mode — both decide when to step up. His passive punishes raw HP, not armor, so stacking resistances alone is the wrong answer.
audit.corrected: Added real numbers to breakdown.cooldowns and the HP-not-armor point to breakdown.late.

edits.before: Q-poke the contacts and count your notes — every third spell sings twice.
edits.after: His W harass and Nevermove threat put you on the back foot early.

edits.before: W-sustain trades begin: the duo shield-heal makes even exchanges dishonest.
edits.after: His E-plus-support pull threatens a kill setup you can't out-shield yet.

edits.before: E-chains open: slow into root is the lane's longest pick at 3.
edits.after: Swain out-trades you at 3 — Nevermove root plus Q burst wins it.

edits.before: Echo economy: bank the third-cast for the spell the moment wants doubled.
edits.after: His E all-in threat and durability keep you farming safe, not trading.

edits.before: Encore online — the cross-map charm extends through your whole team; fights start two screens early.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension's drain sustain out-heals your poke in any fight he lands E into, so the level favours him.

edits.before: First item spike: echoed Qs chunk and the note ledger compounds.
edits.after: One item and soul stacks make him tanky enough to shrug off your poke.

edits.before: Late Seraphine conducts teamfights: charm the formation, echo the heals, and root whatever the wave spares.
edits.after: Late your longer range and Encore chain-CC finally overtake his sustain, durability, and drain-tank threat.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. Check it before every step-up. - E Beat Drop is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Swain's R (120s CD) drain mode — disengage and reset the fight the moment it starts, not after. - Nevermove (E) is down 12s early, 10s maxed; that's your real trade window. - Your own E Beat Drop is the lifeline — chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: W's heal-if-already-shielded lets you outlast his passive drain — pop it before soul-stack chip adds up, not after.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: Your R only refreshes range on champion hits — landing it on minions wastes the charm's real threat.

edits.before: You conduct: R through your front line into theirs, echo the heals, and root the charmed remainder.
edits.after: You conduct: R through their line — his stacks punish HP, not armor; root the remainder and echo the heals.

notes: This was the packet-flagged defect matchup: chart said Swain wins 6/7 stages, prose said the opposite. Content-layer win[N]/whys[N] were already correct and well-researched; only the full-layer side+why needed to catch up, which this proposal does as matched pairs so regression-check sees full and content agreeing. mirrorAlreadyAudited=false.
